drhp.business: Kavveri Defence & Wireless Technologies (formerly Kavveri Telecom Products) designs and manufactures antennas, filters/duplexers/multiplexers, switches/switch matrices and other RF components and subsystems, serving defence, aerospace, railroad transport, airports, industrial/utility (SCADA/AMI) and telecommunications customers. The Company holds design, tooling, assembly and measurement in-house across facilities in Bangalore, India and Kemptville, Ontario, Canada.

Fabrication is carried out at the Company's own facilities in Bangalore, India and Kemptville, Ontario, Canada, and management states an intent to bring more fabrication processes in-house across both sites in a capital-disciplined way, to shorten development cycles.
